decisions.reason: As a piping-system metal component it is close enough to the firm’s existing fabrication knowledge to be improved from early customer feedback, but the weaker website prominence suggests a somewhat higher risk than the bracket products.

A ceiling or floor pipe bracket fits very closely with the firm’s established metalworking capabilities, so management is likely to retain it and learn from initial market use rather than exit quickly.

A pipe support bracket strongly builds on related fabrication know-how and can be incrementally refined using the firm’s existing technical knowledge and customer learning, making withdrawal unlikely.
